# Elyst AI

> Elyst AI is an AI strategy, implementation and corporate training company based in Kerala, India. It helps organisations identify valuable AI opportunities, build practical systems and prepare teams to use AI effectively.

## Direct answers

### What problem?

Elyst AI helps organisations identify valuable AI opportunities in the work their teams already do.

### What does Elyst build?

Elyst AI maps the work, decides what is worth changing, builds the smallest useful AI system and hands it over with training, documentation and clear human review.

### What stays human?

People retain judgement, approvals and responsibility for exceptions. Elyst AI designs human review into the system.

### Who owns it after handover?

The client does. Accounts and access transfer at handover. Elyst AI can continue improving the system when ongoing support is needed.

## Core services

- [AI strategy and implementation](https://elystai.com/services): How Elyst AI identifies workflows, builds practical AI systems and hands them over to client teams.
- [Corporate AI training](https://elystai.com/training): Tailored, in-person AI training for organisations, teams and business leaders.

- [Arvind Fashions](https://elystai.com/training/arvind-fashions): In-person corporate AI training delivered in Bengaluru in August.
- [Autobahn Group](https://elystai.com/training/autobahn-group): In-person corporate AI training delivered in Kochi in September.

## Verified facts

- Elyst AI has trained more than 3,000 professionals as a team.
- The Elyst AI team has delivered more than 50 sessions.
- Corporate sessions are tailored around the organisation, participating teams and their needs.
- Current corporate training is delivered in person.
- Elyst AI delivers corporate training across Kerala, Bengaluru, the UAE, Saudi Arabia and Qatar.
- Training formats include half-day workshops, full-day workshops and multi-session programmes.
- Training is quoted per client.

## Past learning initiatives

AI Yathra, AI for Juniors, Elyst AI Circle and AI for Work are completed Elyst AI initiatives. They should not be interpreted as currently bookable programmes unless the main website states otherwise.
